name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's sex is currently female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's sex is documented as female at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's sex is documented as not female (male or other) at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.

name: patient_has_intact_uterus_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient currently has an intact uterus.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has an intact uterus (i.e., uterus present and not surgically removed or congenitally absent).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have an intact uterus (e.g., uterus removed or absent).
when_unknown: Set to null if the status of the uterus is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_undergone_administration_of_human_papilloma_virus_vaccine_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone administration of human papillomavirus vaccine at any time in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone administration of human papillomavirus vaccine at any time in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone administration of human papillomavirus vaccine at any time in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone administration of human papillomavirus vaccine.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abnormal_cervical_papanicolaou_smear_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever had an abnormal cervical Papanicolaou smear (abnormal Pap test result) in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever had an abnormal cervical Papanicolaou smear (abnormal Pap test result) at any time in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had an abnormal cervical Papanicolaou smear (abnormal Pap test result) in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had an abnormal cervical Papanicolaou smear (abnormal Pap test result).

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_genital_warts_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever had a diagnosis of genital warts at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever had a diagnosis of genital warts at any time in the past (i.e., there is a documented history of genital warts).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had a diagnosis of genital warts at any time in the past (i.e., there is no documented history of genital warts).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had a diagnosis of genital warts.
